vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: phy-founder-fundraising
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle is a collection of templates and strategic frameworks designed to assist founders with investor communications and fundraising. It contains no executable code, suspicious network calls, or instructions that would lead to data exfiltration or unauthorized system access. All content in SKILL.md is aligned with its stated purpose of generating investor updates and pitch narratives.

llm.summary: An instruction-only fundraising communications skill whose requirements and instructions are coherent with its stated purpose and do not request extra credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: The skill name/description (fundraising communications) matches the SKILL.md content (investor updates, pitch deck, outreach, meeting scripts). It does not request unrelated binaries, credentials, or system access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions stay on-topic (templates, cadence, outreach strategy, meeting scripts). Two minor scope notes: (1) the doc references a separate 'founder-gtm' skill and a local file 'references/narrative.md' that are not included or declared — this is a usability/coherence issue (missing dependency/content) rather than an obvious security concern; (2) the skill triggers on a set of broad keywords (e.g., 'fundraising', 'raise', 'investor update') which may cause frequent/autonomous invocation when those terms appear.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files (instruction-only). Nothing is written to disk and no external downloads or package installs are triggered.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The instructions do not ask for secrets or system credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and default model invocation are set. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but the skill does not request permanent/system-level privileges or modify other skills' configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and focused on investor communications. Before installing: (1) be aware it activates on broad fundraising-related keywords — if you don't want accidental activations, consider limiting triggers or only invoking it explicitly; (2) it references another skill ('founder-gtm') and a local file ('references/narrative.md') that are not bundled — expect missing content or reduced functionality unless you also install/provide those; (3) the skill will not have access to your email, bank, or cloud accounts unless you explicitly grant those via other integrations — never supply credentials to the skill itself. If you plan to let the agent send emails, wire funds, or access external accounts, verify separately what connectors or credentials are required and review those integrations for proportionality and safety.
